body: @Calinou please hide these tests under spoiler. Scrolling it is almost infinite 😅

@Calinou It is very surprising that `AStar` is slower. When I benchmarked, I had about +20%. Also, I don't think that the 3x improvement of HashSet/OAHashMap in insert, search, delete, and iteration has resulted in performance degradation.
